item_name: Rothco Backwoods Waxed Canvas Log Carrier
item_short_desc: Easily transport cut logs, split wood, and an assortment of branches from the wilderness to your campgrounds with our Backwoods Wax Canvas Log Carrier. The open-end design allows you carry different lengths of wood and can be laid down flat for easier loading. This design also makes it easy to unload logs into a wood box or log rack.
description: Easily transport cut logs, split wood, and an assortment of branches from the wilderness to your campgrounds with our Backwoods Wax Canvas Log Carrier. The open-end design allows you carry different lengths of wood and can be laid down flat for easier loading. This design also makes it easy to unload logs into a wood box or log rack. Top Grade Waxed Canvas: Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. These log carrier bags are made of heavy-duty waxed cotton canvas for a handsome and weather-stricken look that can tackle harsh outdoor elements. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of premium canvas bags and packs. Built Like a Lumberjack: The leather trim strap provides additional support throughout the center, ensuring that the firewood remains stacked and secured. Reinforced with box X stitching and brass grommets, the leather-wrapped web handles easily withstand heavy loads. The leather handle wrap offers extra cushioning and comfort as you haul wood to-and-fro. All-Weather Design: Whether you are collecting tree limbs and branches for a campfire or transporting split wood inside for a fireplace, the canvas log carrier is built to be used both indoors and outdoors. The weather-resistant wax canvas material can safely be placed onto snow as you load your winter stockpile into the house. Easy to Store: Measuring 38 inch x 28 inch, the firewood carrier is capable of hauling large loads while maintaining a size that is easy to fold for storage. Conveniently hang the log carrier on a hook or tuck it away underneath a firewood rack.
